raw.notable_prerequisites: The first three modes of Demonic Pact have been selected.
produces: Target opponent loses the game at the beginning of their next upkeep
raw.steps:
Cast Donate by paying {2}{U}, giving control of Demonic Pact to an opponent.
At the beginning of the opponent's upkeep, Demonic Pact triggers, causing them to select the fourth mode and lose the game.

raw.easy_prerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
raw.notable_prerequisites: The first three modes of Demonic Pact have been selected.
produces: Target opponent loses the game at the beginning of their next upkeep
raw.steps:
Activate Coveted Falcon by paying {1}{U}, turning it face up.
Coveted Falcon triggers, causing an opponent to gain control of Demonic Pact and causing you to draw a card.
At the beginning of the opponent's upkeep, Demonic Pact triggers, causing them to select the fourth mode and lose the game.
